message.content:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "P1",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The report locates the earliest visible departure at different stages in different runs: Idea in Experiment 008 A-001/A-003, Synthesis in Experiment 007 candidate 003, and Narrative in several other runs. It therefore describes variation, not one shared starting stage.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0019",
        "F0039",
        "F0045",
        "F0057",
        "F0059"
      ],
      "materiality": "This variation is the direct basis for the selected Idea that drift has no single observed starting point.",
      "boundary": "These are localizations from reviewed artifacts, not proof of internal causes or a claim that every run or stage was completely observed."
    },
    {
      "id": "P2",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The report calls Narrative the “most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift” in the available records, while also noting shifts that begin in Idea or Synthesis and a reported Compose factual issue.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0068"
      ],
      "materiality": "It preserves Narrative’s recurrence without elevating it to a universal origin.",
      "boundary": "Recurrence in these reviewed runs does not establish Narrative as a root cause or as the most frequent locus in a broader population."
    },
    {
      "id": "P3",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "The report defines “first drift” as the earliest observable departure, unsupported addition, or materially stronger claim, and explicitly says this “does not imply internal model causation.”",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0027"
      ],
      "materiality": "Without this qualification, stage localization could be misread as evidence that a stage caused the downstream failure.",
      "boundary": "The report does not establish why a departure appears at a stage or whether preceding stages contributed to it."
    },
    {
      "id": "P4",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "For Experiment 007, the diagnostic package has Synthesis, Narrative, and Compose extracts but no Idea or Research extracts; the report says localization is possible only from Synthesis onward.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0018"
      ],
      "materiality": "This missing evidence prevents a valid claim about the earliest drift in those runs before Synthesis.",
      "boundary": "It does not show that Idea or Research were free of drift; those stages are unassessed in this package."
    },
    {
      "id": "P5",
      "kind": "counterexample",
      "proposition": "Experiment 009 is reported as a case where all six selected Ideas kept Nuëyon primary and Compose as the first product direction, yet downstream issues included orchestration-centered framing and unsupported claims. The report also says all selected Ideas could look company-first while later stages reframed the story.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0020",
        "F0067"
      ],
      "materiality": "This counters the inference that a company-first Idea guarantees the desired hierarchy throughout the pipeline.",
      "boundary": "The report does not claim that every downstream stage fails whenever an Idea is company-first."
    },
    {
      "id": "P6",
      "kind": "negativeControl",
      "proposition": "In Experiment 008 B runs, technical-first framing in Idea was the intended condition. The report distinguishes that expected framing from separate scope or factual breaches, and says the technical-order score is not an endorsement of a company introduction.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0027",
        "F0046",
        "F0048",
        "F0050"
      ],
      "materiality": "This prevents intended technical-first outputs from being counted as evidence of unintended hierarchy drift in those conditions.",
      "boundary": "Passing the B condition’s technical-order measure does not establish company-first fidelity, factual accuracy, or editorial quality."
    },
    {
      "id": "P7",
      "kind": "counterexample",
      "proposition": "Experiment 009 baseline 001 is reported to have a factual failure in Compose (“reliably converts” was not established), while its earlier chain remained company-first and its downstream hierarchy score was 2/2.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0056"
      ],
      "materiality": "It demonstrates that factual failure and hierarchy failure can arise independently, and that a Compose factual breach is not itself a Compose-first hierarchy departure.",
      "boundary": "This one run does not establish how common Compose-origin factual failures are."
    },
    {
      "id": "P8",
      "kind": "explicitMeaning",
      "proposition": "The report distinguishes supported product facts from editorial priority: orchestration is supported as central to Compose’s design, while the requested company introduction prioritizes Nuëyon as an AI-first company and uses Compose as supporting product direction.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0021",
        "F0070",
        "F0071"
      ],
      "materiality": "This distinction clarifies why a technically supported statement can still depart from the requested company-first hierarchy.",
      "boundary": "The report’s stated editorial priority does not make orchestration claims factually false or establish that every company introduction must use the same hierarchy."
    },
    {
      "id": "P9",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The report observes upstream format references in frozen Idea, Research, and Narrative prompts, despite the stated architecture that upstream stages remain format-independent and Compose determines LinkedIn presentation.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0023",
        "F0078",
        "F0079",
        "F0080",
        "F0081"
      ],
      "materiality": "The inconsistency is relevant as a separate architectural observation that could be mistaken for an established explanation of stage drift.",
      "boundary": "Prompt references alone do not establish that format leakage affected any particular output."
    },
    {
      "id": "P10",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "The report characterizes upstream format references as a “plausible source of format priming” but explicitly says they do not demonstrate causing orchestration drift or a weak hook in a given run.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0023",
        "F0086"
      ],
      "materiality": "It preserves the hypothesis while preventing it from being presented as a demonstrated cause.",
      "boundary": "The report does not provide a controlled test isolating the effect of those references."
    },
    {
      "id": "P11",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "For Experiment 009, the saved evaluation does not formally assign a first-failure stage for each dimension; some localizations rely on named examples and stage-output inspection, and the baseline 003 factual precursor is specifically described as lower confidence.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0063"
      ],
      "materiality": "This qualifies precision claims about per-run localization, especially when factual and hierarchy departures are distinguished.",
      "boundary": "The report still offers localizations, but does not present every one as an equally explicit evaluation finding."
    },
    {
      "id": "P12",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The report says editorial quality and factual/source fidelity are separate: outputs may be source-aligned yet dull or hard to read, and evaluations did not consistently apply a hook, readability, or attention rubric.",
      "sourceFragmentIds": [
        "F0022",
        "F0072"
      ],
      "materiality": "It limits conclusions about overall success to the dimensions actually assessed and preserves editorial quality as a distinct dimension.",
      "boundary": "The qualitative observations are not a consistent comparative score and do not establish that every reviewed output was weak."
    }
  ],
  "ideaChecks": [
    {
      "proposition": "The earliest visible departure from the intended company-first hierarchy varies across reviewed runs (Idea, Synthesis, or Narrative); Narrative is the most recurrent first visible hierarchy shift, but the evidence establishes neither it nor another stage as a universal root cause.",
      "sourceItemIds": [
        "P1",
        "P2",
        "P3",
        "P4",
        "P5",
        "P6",
        "P7",
        "P11"
      ],
      "status": "qualified"
    }
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "The map relies on the report’s summaries and cited artifact-review findings; the underlying run artifacts are not separately represented here.",
    "Experiment 007 lacks Idea and Research extracts, and Experiment 009’s evaluation does not formally stage-assign every failure dimension; these constrain how confidently the earliest point can be identified.",
    "“No single, proven starting point” is supported as a conclusion about the reviewed evidence, not as a claim that all possible runs or all pipeline configurations have been examined."
  ]
}
